title: Conference Room in Rec Center
content: For some reason, I have stumble upon a strange area, where I saw men inside a conference room and somehow I just happen to feel the VR/AR components from a projector while it was showing an NFL game. For some reason, it excited me inside the dream due to how extremely realistic the projector was giving me. Then somehow I encountered a woman who was charging 5 dollars inside the room while the rest of the conference room began to be filled up, and then somehow once the room was all filled up, my dream ended abruptly. Best of all, I just woken up about 30 minutes ago from that particular dream while I basically slept through midnight of New Year's Day.
